name: trading
description: Trading content: strategies that could be checked against market data.
card_is: a testable trading idea: what to trade, when to get in, when to get out. General market commentary, motivation and platform walkthroughs are not cards.

fields.name: instrument
fields.description: what is traded, e.g. NIFTY weekly options

fields.name: entry
fields.description: the entry rule as stated; keep times and numbers exact

fields.name: exit
fields.description: stop, target or time exit as stated

fields.name: sizing
fields.description: lots, capital or risk per trade as stated

fields.name: regime
fields.description: when the creator says it works or fails

fields.name: edge
fields.description: the result the creator claims (a claim, not evidence)
